validationRule.title: Sequential stop_time_update times are not increasing
validationRule.errorDescription: stop_time_update arrival/departure times between sequential stops should always increase - they should never be the same or decrease.
validationRule.occurrenceSuffix: - times must increase between two sequential stops

occurrenceList.prefix: trip_id 1 stop_sequence 2 arrival_time 17:16:40 (1700000200) is less than previous stop arrival_time 17:20:00 (1700000400)
trip_id 1 stop_sequence 2 arrival_time 17:16:40 (1700000200) is less than previous stop departure_time 17:18:20 (1700000300)

validationRule.title: stop_time_update departure time is before arrival time
validationRule.errorDescription: Within the same stop_time_update, arrival and departures times can be the same, or the departure time can be later than the arrival time - the departure time should never come before the arrival time.
validationRule.occurrenceSuffix: - departure time must be equal to or greater than arrival time

occurrenceList.prefix: trip_id 1 stop_sequence 1 departure_time 17:18:20 (1700000300) is less than the same stop arrival_time 17:20:00 (1700000400)
